scope: Gap-level conclusions; the 840 native originals are an exhaustive candidate screen, not 840 approved anatomical units. No new geometry invented.

findings.finding: Two anterior ulnar recurrent segments, distinct original identities with native side and proximal parent contact. Zero sampled bone depth. Full-current-tissue check supersedes the initial baseline-only zero muscle result: superficial flexor contacts about 0.64/0.63 mm, retained as an explicit schematic source-interface limitation; not clinical precision. Other forearm candidates show 6.21–21.89 mm separation from the available parent, and are not joined with invented geometry.

findings.finding: Common regional registrations do not preserve neighboring interfaces: external carotids enter mandible 1.16–1.56 mm and SCM 3.57–4.24 mm; external jugulars intersect pulmonary surface 4.64–5.68 mm; deep femoral arteries intersect adductor 5.60–6.65 mm; fibular arteries enter fibula 2.76–4.78 mm. Existing accepted femoral branches remain intact.

159 regional node objects plus bilateral tonsils inspected. Regional fit does not validate the distributed chains: iliac nodes penetrate descending colon up to 20.67 mm, axillary/gluteal groups overlap muscles, and tonsils enter sphenoid 1.15/1.27 mm. No isolated node is substituted for a whole network.

findings.finding: No reusable, identified body-course geometry with an approved source lock in the reviewed open sources. NIH valve is a theoretical local construct; XCAT is a distinct license/access blocker; publications do not supply the needed redistributable duct meshes. This is a bounded search conclusion, not worldwide nonexistence.

findings.finding: Real cortex, pyramids, columns, papillae and collecting structures, per-asset BY4 metadata/DOIs preserved. Fresh positive global similarity and common abdominopelvic rigid fit has RMS 15.161 mm / sampled max 47.086 mm. Capsule RMS 11.077 mm left and 10.081 mm right; visual boundaries disagree. No per-piece adjustment or overlay. Z NC kidney remains excluded.

Original identities inspected. Superior/inferior left segmental candidates have no parent-trunk contact (minimum surface separation 10.763/14.422 mm) and extend outside the existing renal surface. Other branches show ureter intersections up to 6.49 mm; near-coincident parent-trunk variants cannot be duplicated as new independent owners. No connector invented.

Initial trunk classification preserved as invalid attempt1. Correct craniofacial registration still places adenohypophysis/neurohypophysis into sphenoid 0.725/0.214 mm and protrudes from existing hypophysis up to 0.89 mm. This small gland has no approved safe enclosing/osseous interface; initial trunk soft results are not evidence for the corrected gland.

Fresh common visceral fit across bladder, prostate, seminal glands and deferent ducts: RMS 6.029 mm / max 31.816 mm. Z ducts remain separated from urethra by at least 2.68/2.61 mm and protrude from prostate; source tips are not moved individually. HRA common abdominopelvic fit also fails. Existing urinary urethra not duplicated.

findings.source: Original Z/BP3D inventories; HRA male prostate; primary microscopy study
findings.finding: No separately identified open 3D bulbourethral, scrotal-envelope or foreskin mesh approved in reviewed sources. HRA prostate original has 18 meshes including ejaculatory ducts and zones, not the missing named glands/envelopes. An article or an existing external-genital owner does not supply those surfaces.

110 source regional surfaces retain original topology; common regional fit intersects current muscle surfaces by several millimetres (legs up to 12.25 mm). HRA skin supplies one whole surface, not named regional segmentation. No cuts applied to existing skin.

Publisher explicitly describes skin patches thickened at biopsy sites (three abdominal areas), not segmentation of the complete macroscopic subcutaneous layer. Cannot relabel these as complete hypodermis.

Hand plates are displaced from existing skin (median 14.23/16.73 mm); foot bone registration does not validate skin interfaces. Foot plates partly intersect tissue and partly float: maximum distance to skin 4.78/3.89 mm, visible source/target surface disagreement. No separate plate adjustment.

Real bowel components from a different source; one common colon fit to ascending/descending/rectum gives RMS 14.464 mm / max 64.216 mm. No individual cecum/sigmoid fit. Ten source meshes do not include an identified full anal canal, and approved existing sphincter coverage remains partial.

Original named macro components exist in a different donor frame. Common abdominopelvic trial fails, including withheld pancreas RMS 28.072/max 47.086 mm. No overlay of foreign subdivisions into the current organs. Earlier accepted mesoappendix and other source-native coverage retained.
